sections.title: Poe Souls
sections.note: Imp Poes can only be seen and beaten as a wolf with senses on. Outdoors most appear only at night (tag Night).

items.name: Jovani's house
items.area: Jovani's house, Castle Town
items.howTo: As a wolf, dig under the wall where the cats gather in Castle Town to get into Jovani's house. The Poe floats over his pile of gold; Jovani then asks you to hunt the rest.
items.after: After Lakebed Temple, on your way to Zelda as a wolf

items.name: Sacred Grove boulder
items.area: Sacred Grove, the clearing where you first fight Skull Kid
items.howTo: Bomb the big boulder in the middle of the clearing to free the Poe.
items.notes: No source says whether this one is night-only.

items.name: Faron Woods mist stump
items.area: Faron Woods, the purple-fog area
items.howTo: In the misty part of the woods, follow Midna's jumps as a wolf to a round clearing with a large hollow stump. The Poe floats there at night.

items.name: Faron Field cliff
items.area: Hyrule Field (Faron), small cliff north of the shallow water
items.howTo: At night, look on the small cliff just north of the shallow water in the field between Faron Woods and Castle Town.

items.name: Kakariko Gorge tree
items.area: Kakariko Gorge, raised cliff by the bridge
items.howTo: At night, climb the raised cliff with a tree next to the Kakariko Gorge bridge; the Poe's lantern is by the tree.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki puts the cliff east of the gorge (GameCube), StrategyWiki west of the bridge; Zelda Dungeon says the middle of the area.

items.name: Kakariko Gorge lantern cavern
items.area: Cave south of the Kakariko Gorge bridge
items.howTo: Bomb open the cave south of the gorge bridge and take a full Lantern. At the forks go right, right, left, left to the deepest room. Any time of day.
items.notes: Fork directions are GameCube/HD Normal (Zelda Dungeon); mirrored on Wii and in Hero Mode.

items.name: Kakariko bomb storehouse
items.area: Kakariko Village, the ruined storehouse above Barnes Bombs
items.howTo: Go up through Barnes Bombs and out of the top floor to the wrecked storehouse. The Poe floats over the ruins at night.

items.name: Kakariko lookout
items.area: Kakariko Village, by Talo's lookout tower
items.howTo: Follow the slope up from the ruined storehouse; the Poe is beside the lookout tower at night.

items.name: Graveyard
items.area: Kakariko Graveyard
items.howTo: Floats in the middle of the graveyard at night.

items.name: Graveyard gravestone
items.area: Kakariko Graveyard, south-west corner
items.howTo: At night, push the gravestone in the south-west corner of the graveyard (the first on the right) as a wolf and the Poe pops out.

items.name: Death Mountain ledge
items.area: Death Mountain Trail, the upper ledge
items.howTo: Get a boost from the second Goron on the trail but aim west and grab the ledge. At night the Poe is just to the south.

items.name: Castle Town east bridge
items.area: Hyrule Field (Eldin), wooden bridge outside Castle Town's east gate
items.howTo: Hovers over the wooden bridge just outside Castle Town's east gate at night.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon lists this under Sacred Grove by mistake.

items.name: Castle Town south stairs
items.area: Hyrule Field, the stone patio below Castle Town's south gate
items.howTo: Leave Castle Town by the south gate; the Poe is on the stairs down to the stone patio at night.

items.name: Field ruins amphitheatre
items.area: Hyrule Field west of Castle Town, the ruined amphitheatre with an Owl Statue
items.howTo: Go south-west from the Castle Town portal, over a small hill, to the ruined amphitheatre. The Poe is there at night.

items.name: North field grotto: first Poe
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Castle Town, ring of tall grass by two trees
items.howTo: West of the stone bridge, dig as a wolf in the middle of the ring of tall grass by two trees. The grotto below has Deku Babas and two Poes.

items.name: North field grotto: second Poe
items.area: Same grotto
items.howTo: The second of the two Poes in the grass-ring grotto.

items.name: North field stone bridge
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Castle Town, the stone bridge
items.howTo: On the stone bridge in the middle of the field north of Castle Town, at night.

items.name: Crag below the Great Bridge
items.area: Road up from Faron Field to the Great Bridge of Hylia
items.howTo: On the road with the fire-arrow Bulblin Archers, Bomb-Arrow the boulders high on the cliff to uncover Clawshot targets, then follow them up to the Poe at night.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki says south of the bridge; Zelda Dungeon's text says north.

items.name: Isle of Riches
items.area: Lake Hylia, Isle of Riches
items.howTo: Play Falbi's Flight-by-Fowl at night and glide a Cucco onto the Isle of Riches. The Poe is on one of its tiers.
items.notes: Sources disagree on the tier: Zelda Dungeon says the second from the bottom, Zelda's Palace the third or higher, StrategyWiki the prize platform.

items.name: Ledge below Flight-by-Fowl
items.area: Lake Hylia, ledge on the north wall under Falbi's
items.howTo: Start Flight-by-Fowl at night and U-turn straight away to land on the ledge directly under the launch platform.

items.name: Lake Hylia east islet
items.area: Lake Hylia, the patch of land on the east side
items.howTo: Swim to the small patch of land on the east side of the lake at night.

items.name: Lake Hylia south shore
items.area: Lake Hylia, grassy ledges on the south shore
items.howTo: Walk the grassy ledges along the south shore at night; the lantern shows near the middle.

items.name: Lake Hylia watchtower
items.area: Lake Hylia, foot of the stone lookout tower
items.howTo: Climb up to the base of the lookout tower in the south-west of the lake at night.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki and StrategyWiki give south-west (GameCube); Zelda Dungeon says west.

items.name: Lake Hylia lantern cavern: first Poe
items.area: Cave in the south of Lake Hylia, up the ladder
items.howTo: Bomb open the long dark cavern at the top of the ladder in the south of the lake. The first Poe is in a lantern room near the start.

items.name: Lake Hylia lantern cavern: second Poe
items.area: Same cavern, about halfway
items.howTo: The second Poe is in another lantern room about halfway through.

items.name: Lake Hylia lantern cavern: third Poe
items.area: Same cavern, last chamber
items.howTo: The third is in the final chamber with the Piece of Heart.

items.name: Zora's River fork
items.area: Upper Zora's River, grassy land where the river forks
items.howTo: Swim to the grassy knoll between the branches of the river in the south of the area at night.

items.name: Zora's Domain east ledge
items.area: Zora's Domain, below the waterfall
items.howTo: From the pool below the waterfall, swim to the land on the east side and follow it to the end at night.

items.name: Zora's Domain cliffs
items.area: Zora's Domain, cliffs from the west side of the pool to the north
items.howTo: As a wolf, use Midna's jumps up the cliffs from the west side of the pool round to the north. The Poe waits in one of the gaps at night.

items.name: Desert rock by the landing spot
items.area: Gerudo Desert, the rock south of where Fyer's cannon lands you
items.howTo: Head south from where you land in the desert to the small rock platform. The Poe is there at night.

items.name: Gerudo Mesa
items.area: Gerudo Mesa, by the Cave of Ordeals
items.howTo: Once the Bridge of Eldin's middle is warped home, the Poe floats high on the mesa by the Cave of Ordeals entrance at night.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Desert path to the camp
items.area: Gerudo Desert, narrow sandy paths in the north-west before the Bulblin Camp
items.howTo: Just before the far north area, turn west along the narrow path and follow it to the end at night; enemies ambush you there.

items.name: Three skulls bluff
items.area: Gerudo Desert, bluff with a tree and three skulls
items.howTo: Clawshot to the Peahat/tree on the bluff in the north of the desert and run on to the ring of three skulls. The Poe floats there at night.

items.name: Three skulls grotto: first Poe
items.area: Grotto inside the ring of three skulls
items.howTo: Dig as a wolf between the three skulls to drop into a grotto with two Poes.

items.name: Three skulls grotto: second Poe
items.area: Same grotto
items.howTo: The second Poe attacks once the first is beaten.

items.name: King Bulblin's arena
items.area: Bulblin Camp, where you fight King Bulblin
items.howTo: Go back at night to the spot in the camp where you fought King Bulblin.
items.after: After beating King Bulblin at the Bulblin Camp

items.name: Steps to Arbiter's Grounds
items.area: Outside Arbiter's Grounds, west of the entrance
items.howTo: Climbing the steps to the Arbiter's Grounds, go west at the landing and follow the side corridor to the Poe at night.
items.after: After beating King Bulblin at the Bulblin Camp

items.name: Arbiter's Grounds: central chamber Poe
items.area: Central chamber, first floor
items.howTo: Four Poes snatch the flames in the central chamber and three leave: beat the one that stays. All four are needed to open the way on.

items.name: Arbiter's Grounds: round room Poe
items.area: Round room in the north-east, after the basement
items.howTo: Track the Poe scent to the round room you reach on coming back up from the basement.

items.name: Arbiter's Grounds: chain Poe
items.area: Sinking-sand room with Stalfos and ReDeads
items.howTo: Beat the skeletons and ReDeads, dig up the chain as a wolf and pull it to reveal the third Poe.

items.name: Arbiter's Grounds: Poe with copies
items.area: Room just west of the central chamber
items.howTo: The last Poe splits into three copies; the real one glows brighter.

items.name: Snowpeak: past the two rocks
items.area: Snowpeak, path up the mountain
items.howTo: Going up the mountain, pass between two large rocks close together; the Poe is just beyond, to the right, at night.

items.name: Snowpeak: lone tree
items.area: Snowpeak, by a lone tree off the scent trail
items.howTo: Where the Reekfish Scent goes up a cliff, take the ramp to the left back to the trail, then go left at the top to a lone tree. The Poe is there at night.

items.name: Snowpeak: tree at the fork
items.area: Snowpeak, first tree after the fork in the trail
items.howTo: Follow the Reekfish Scent to a fork, go right and look by the first tree at night.

items.name: Snowpeak: bluff by the ruins
items.area: The spiralling snowy bluff south-east of the Snowpeak Ruins entrance
items.howTo: As a wolf, climb the spiralling bluff outside the ruins; the Poe is on top at night. Don't fall off the edge.

items.name: Snowpeak Ruins: foyer
items.area: Entrance hall
items.howTo: Floats over the ice in the middle of the first room.

items.name: Snowpeak Ruins: suit of armour
items.area: Entrance hall, middle suit of armour on the east side
items.howTo: Of the three suits of armour on each side of the entrance hall, smash the middle one on the east side with two hits of the Ball and Chain.

items.name: Snowpeak Ruins: ice wall
items.area: Second floor, south-east room (above the kitchen)
items.howTo: Break the ice barrier on the east wall with the Ball and Chain to reveal the Poe in an alcove.

items.name: Snowpeak Top cave ice
items.area: Cave leading up to Snowpeak Top
items.howTo: In the cave up to Snowpeak Top, smash the ice chunk on the left (at the foot of the ladder) with the Ball and Chain.

items.name: Sacred Grove waterfall
items.area: Sacred Grove, the maze where you chase Skull Kid
items.howTo: Pass under the small waterfall and climb the roots and blocks to a large hollow stump where the Poe floats.
items.notes: No source says whether this one is night-only.

items.name: Master Sword pedestal
items.area: Sacred Grove, the Master Sword's clearing
items.howTo: Floats in the open in the clearing where the Master Sword lay, at night.
items.notes: StrategyWiki says to come back after the Temple of Time.

items.name: Temple of Time: behind the gold gate
items.area: Third floor, large round elevator room, west side
items.howTo: Walk a small statue with the Dominion Rod onto the switch behind the gold gate (or smash the gate with the big statue), then go in as a wolf.

items.name: Temple of Time: above the scales
items.area: Scale room near the top, before the Boss Key
items.howTo: Weigh down one side of the scales with statues, stand on the other to rise, Clawshot to the ceiling target and ride the Spinner rail to the high southern ledge with the Poe.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki and StrategyWiki call it the sixth floor, Zelda Dungeon the seventh.

items.name: Hidden Village balcony
items.area: Hidden Village, a house balcony
items.howTo: Clawshot up to the balcony of the house at the village's far corner; the Poe is there at night.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki says the north-east house (GameCube), StrategyWiki the north-west corner.

items.name: Temple of Time: owl statue
items.area: Entrance hall, south-west corner
items.howTo: Move the Owl Statue in the south-west corner of the entrance hall (right at the foot of the stairs) with the Dominion Rod and a Poe flies out.
items.after: Once the Dominion Rod's power is restored
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon calls this Sacred Grove (Past).

items.name: City in the Sky: Peahat island
items.area: West wing, third floor, room of moving Peahats
items.howTo: Clawshot along the Peahats to the small island on the far side of the room.

items.name: City in the Sky: Big Key room
items.area: Fourth floor, outdoor room before the Big Key
items.howTo: Climb the vines as Link and walk the ropes as a wolf to the platform with a chest on the west side; the Poe is beside it.

items.name: Cave of Ordeals floor 17
items.area: Cave of Ordeals, floor 17
items.howTo: Beat the Stalhounds first, then the Poe.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored
items.notes: The Spinner is needed past floor 11 (StrategyWiki says the Clawshot).

items.name: Cave of Ordeals floor 33
items.area: Cave of Ordeals, floor 33
items.howTo: Beat the four ReDeads (Ball and Chain), then the Poe.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Cave of Ordeals floor 44
items.area: Cave of Ordeals, floor 44
items.howTo: Clear the Armored Lizalfos (Bomb Arrows from the ledge help), then the Poe.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

sections.title: Jovani's rewards
sections.note: Talk to Jovani as your soul count passes 20 and 60.

items.name: 20 Poe Souls
items.area: Jovani's house, Castle Town
items.howTo: Return to Jovani with 20 or more Poe Souls. Gengle is freed and Jovani can move again, but he stays golden and asks for 60.
items.notes: HD: he also gives the Ghost Lantern, which lights up when an Imp Poe is in the area, day or night, and goes out when the area's Poes are all gone.

items.name: 60 Poe Souls
items.area: Jovani's house, Castle Town
items.howTo: Bring all 60 Poe Souls to Jovani. The curse lifts completely and he thanks you before leaving to find his girlfriend.
items.notes: Zelda's Palace says Jovani gives 200 Rupees here; other sources only mention Gengle's.

items.name: Gengle's Rupees
items.area: Jovani's house, Castle Town
items.howTo: After 60 souls, find Jovani crying in Telma's Bar, then go back to his house: Gengle gives you 200 Rupees from the hoard every time you visit.
items.notes: HD: Gengle also gives the Rupee stamp.
